subject: general
question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

Aid workers have delivered vast quantities of food on the refugee camps.
solution:
The erroneous part is **'on the refugee camps'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'to the refugee camps' **should be used instead of** 'on the refugee camps'.**
 
• In the given sentence **'delivered to'** is a phrasal verb.
 
• It means 'to take goods, letters, parcels, etc. to people's houses or places of work'. (लोगों के घरों या कार्यस्थलों पर सामान, पत्र, पार्सल आदि ले जाने के लिए)
 
 
• *Example: Mail is **delivered to** our office twice a day.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 3.**

**​Correct Sentence:__** *Aid workers have delivered vast quantities of food** to the refugee camps.***
